# ReadByte <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Streams](BlitzBasic-Streams)

```blitzbasic
ReadByte:Int32 stream:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream to read from. |

**Returns:** The next byte of the stream, from 0 to 255.

_Not documented yet._
